name: Power distribution board with precharge and soft switch
realWorldEquivalent: mjbots power_dist r4.5b (XT90 in, XT30 outputs, precharge, switch input)
notes: Ratings are conservative placeholders; confirm current and voltage limits on the mjbots datasheet before relying on them. Precharge limits inrush into the motor drivers' bus capacitors; the switch input takes a latching e-stop.

name: 16 mm latching emergency-stop button
realWorldEquivalent: 16 mm panel-mount latching mushroom e-stop (e.g. IDEC XA series)
notes: Wired to a power distribution board's switch input, so it carries signal current only and does not break the main bus directly.

name: 25 A blade fuse in inline holder
realWorldEquivalent: Littelfuse 0257025 ATO 25 A, 32 V, with an inline 12 AWG holder

name: 10 A blade fuse in inline holder
realWorldEquivalent: Littelfuse 0257010 ATO 10 A, 32 V, with an inline 16 AWG holder

name: Panel toggle power switch 15 A
realWorldEquivalent: Panel-mount SPST toggle switch rated 15 A at 28 V DC

name: CAN FD bus transceiver
notes: Up to 5 Mbit/s in the CAN FD data phase; switchable 120 ohm termination on board. Logic I/O accepts 3-5 V.
